Fonts used by the ggbasket theme

Source: R/theme.R
ggbasket_fonts.Rd

Returns the first installed family from each preference list: body (Fira Sans Condensed, Roboto Condensed, Arial Narrow), title (Fira Sans, Roboto, Helvetica Neue) and mono (Roboto Mono, Fira Mono, Menlo). Falls back to "sans"/"mono" when none is installed, when the current device is base pdf()/postscript(), or when options(ggbasket.family) is set.

Usage

ggbasket_fonts()

Value

A list with body, title and mono.

Examples

ggbasket_fonts()
#> $body
#> [1] "Fira Sans Condensed"
#> 
#> $title
#> [1] "Fira Sans"
#> 
#> $mono
#> [1] "Roboto Mono"
#>
